history: Notre Dame Information Technology Club (NDITC), a co-curricular activities club of the prestigious Notre Dame College, started its journey in 2018 to promote and support learning and interaction within areas related to information systems and technology, share new ideas, and encourage recreational activities in these areas. Being the first club of Notre Dame College devoted to encouraging students to take part and make contributions to the ever-evolving IT sector, NDITC is dedicated to setting an example.
objectives: The club aspires to encourage its members to discover their untapped zeal for information and technology, provide necessary guidelines and opportunities, and act as the leading light in spreading technological awareness among pupils. The club has taken the solemn oath to uphold the rich history of Notre Dame College and ignite the thirst for knowledge about the technology world, constructing the pathway towards a technologically advanced nation.
